meta.title: Eclipse for restaurants
meta.description: The menu with Gus, the waiter who takes your order, the venue CRM and games for the table. Try the Lucero demo.

hero.sub: Your venue on the phone too: the menu with Gus, the waiter who takes every order, the venue CRM and games for the table.
hero.statusNote: Three plans with published prices. We set it up over WhatsApp.
hero.demoNote: Lucero is a fictional venue, built to show the product.

offer.title: Everything that happens at the table.
offer.lead: Guests scan the QR, browse the menu and order. Gus writes it down, takes the ticket to the kitchen and comes back with the dish. You see it all in the CRM.

carta.name: Menu with Gus
carta.text: The menu on the phone, with an animated waiter who writes down every dish, takes the ticket and comes back with the tray.

crm.name: Venue CRM
crm.text: Live orders, kitchen, customers with their history and the menu with stock, on one screen.

juegos.name: Games and wheel
juegos.text: While the food is on its way: phone games and a prize wheel to win the daily menu or a deal.

academy.name: Table and Academy
academy.text: Games for everyone at the table —draw and guess, hockey— and Eclipse Academy: ideas for digital and on-site marketing.

demo.title: Try it before you choose.
demo.lead: Lucero is a fictional venue. Order from the table as a guest and watch the venue CRM at the same time.

steps.crm: Handle the order in the CRM

demo.asPlan: See the demo as the plan

plans.title: Three plans. Pick yours.
plans.lead: In US dollars, per month. Each plan includes everything in the one before.

plans.note: Eclipse for restaurants is in the works: message us and we set up the start. Nothing is charged on this site.
